channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Beer Manufacture Simulator
item.description: Brew your own beer from scratch! Take on the role of a brewmaster, learn brewing techniques, create unique recipes, and grow your craft brewery into a full-scale factory. Expand your brewery from mashing and fermenting to bottling and selling - every decision shapes your beer empire.

item.title: Crackheads
item.description: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.

item.title: Granule
item.description: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

item.title: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days
item.description: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion adventure game where you work alongside Meru Momozono. Customize your Pomodoro timer, to-do list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds. As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.

item.title: PARANORMASIGHT: The Mermaid's Curse
item.description: Will you survive the curse together this summer? A new supernatural mystery adventure begins, telling a bittersweet story of the passions of youth featuring new locations, new legends and a new cast of characters.

item.title: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
item.description: How far would you go to bring someone back from the dead? Discover the depths that some will go to in this horror-adventure game.

item.title: Pool of Madness
item.description: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

item.title: Round and Round Inc.
item.description: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.

item.title: Swarmbreaker
item.description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

item.title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
item.description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

item.title: Burning Sword: Death Sun
item.description: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th-century China. Play as Zhang Yixian, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, deep character progression, and an arena built for high scores.

item.title: Graveyard Orbit
item.description: A relaxing space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Clean up the galaxy’s wreckage, piece by piece. Cash in your haul for parts and upgrades. Enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.

item.title: KORRIDOR
item.description: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

item.title: Lord of Undead
item.description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

item.title: Marque & Reprisal
item.description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

item.title: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
item.description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

item.title: MR FARMBOY
item.description: MR FARMBOY is a colony farming game with automation. Build your dream farm, grow crops, raise animals, attract villagers, and hire workers to automate everything.

item.title: Toto's Journey
item.description: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.
